title: Flythrough drawer
description: Camera flythrough controls for previewing and capturing motion.

ui.overview: The Flythrough drawer controls a camera motion sequence that can be used for recording or previewing route movement. It keeps the scene visible while you tune how the movement behaves.

controls.label: Play / stop
controls.description: Starts or stops the flythrough movement.

controls.label: Direction settings
controls.description: Chooses how the movement runs around the current target.

controls.label: Timing settings
controls.description: Adjusts the duration and pacing of the flythrough.

controls.label: Sync options
controls.description: Links the flythrough with other capture or video state when supported.

steps.title: Prepare the scene
steps.description: Check the journey, widgets, and capture area before starting the movement.

steps.title: Tune the movement
steps.description: Choose the direction, duration, and pacing that fit the intended presentation.

steps.title: Preview and capture
steps.description: Use Play to check the result, then synchronize the sequence with capture when the option is available.

notes: Use this drawer when the camera movement is part of the final output.
Check the scene, widgets, and capture area before starting the movement.
